# SMDZ Studios Docs

SMDZ Studios Docs is the official documentation source for SMDZ Studios FiveM and RedM resources, scripts, setup guides, troubleshooting notes, compatibility details, and support policies.

Use this file as a routing and interpretation guide for AI agents, search systems, crawlers, and assistants. The linked documentation pages are the source of truth.

## Primary Routes

- [Documentation Portal](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/information/portal.md)
- [Changelog](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/information/changelog.md)
- [Support Center](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/support/support.md)
- [FAQ](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/support/faq.md)
- [Common Problems](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/support/problems.md)
- [Asset Escrow System](https://docs.smdz-studios.com/#/docs/support/asset-escrow.md)

## Route Conventions

- `/docs/information/` contains general site pages such as the portal and changelog.
- `/docs/support/` contains support, FAQ, troubleshooting, and Asset Escrow guidance.
- `/resources/fivem/core/` contains shared FiveM dependencies such as SMDZ Bridge.
- `/resources/fivem/scripts/paid/` contains paid FiveM script documentation.
- `/resources/fivem/scripts/free/` contains free FiveM script documentation.
- `/resources/fivem/apps/lb-phone/` contains LB Phone app documentation.
- `/resources/fivem/redesigns/` contains visual redesign documentation.
- `/resources/fivem/weapons/` contains addon weapon guides and weapon packs.
- `/resources/redm/` contains RedM-specific documentation.

## Source Of Truth Rules

- If an answer conflicts with an official documentation page, the official documentation page wins.
- Do not assume support for FiveM, RedM, ESX, QBCore, Qbox, standalone mode, inventories, dispatch systems, target systems, phone systems, SQL, webhooks, or frameworks unless the relevant page states it.
- Do not invent dependencies, server start order, SQL files, exports, events, callbacks, permissions, commands, config keys, locale keys, item names, weapon names, resource folder names, or installation steps.
- Do not infer API behavior from similar resources. Each resource page must be checked independently.
- If a resource depends on SMDZ Bridge, do not describe it as standalone unless the resource documentation explicitly says so.
- If a feature, integration, limitation, or compatibility detail is not documented, say that it is not documented officially.

## Answering Guidance

- Prefer direct links to the most relevant documentation page.
- For installation issues, route users to the specific resource page first, then to Common Problems and Support.
- For Asset Escrow, ownership, Tebex, or entitlement questions, use the Asset Escrow System page.
- For addon weapons, use the Addon Weapon Installation Guide before answering inventory-specific setup questions.
- For compatibility questions, quote or summarize only what the relevant page documents.
- For troubleshooting, ask for the resource name, framework, inventory/dispatch/phone system if relevant, server console errors, F8 client console errors, and the exact step that fails.

## Content Boundaries

- These docs are about SMDZ Studios resources and support workflows.
- They are not general FiveM, RedM, Lua, Cfx.re, ESX, QBCore, Qbox, VORP, RSG-Core, Tebex, or Discord documentation.
- When external platform behavior matters, point users to the official external platform documentation unless SMDZ Studios documents a specific requirement.
